summary: Correctly fixes the inverted control flow in `as_expr` so user-passed symbols are honored instead of being overwritten by `self.ring.symbols`. Minimal, targeted change matching the issue; correct and mergeable.

issues.description: Error message text changed from "not enough symbols" to "Wrong number of symbols". This is actually more accurate (it also fires when too many symbols are passed), but could break any test/code matching the old string. Non-blocking nit.
